title: El coste social
goal: Read how spending cuts and inflation eroded real wages and fueled the informal sector and rising poverty across the 1980s, including hyperinflation in Bolivia and Peru.

items: Explain how spending cuts and inflation eroded real wages.
Describe what happened to the informal sector during this decade.
Describe how spending cuts hit health, education and subsidies.
Describe the hyperinflation in Bolivia in 1985 and Peru in 1989.
Use en detrimento de to name who bears a policy's cost.
